valuation.method: EV / forward revenue. Forward period viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) is FY2028 (year to Jan 2028) total revenue. Anchor: FY2027 product revenue guidance $6,070M (+36%, raised 2 Sep 2026); product is about 96% of total, so FY2027 total revenue is about $6.3B (estimate, no total guide). Scenario FY2028 revenue = $6.3B x (1+growth): 24% bear, 30% base, 36% bull. Equity value = EV + about $2.05B net cash (cash and investments $4.33B less $2.28B convertible notes, 31 Jul 2026) over 380M non-GAAP diluted shares (company guide). Per share in USD on the NYSE listing; no FX or ADR conversion.

bear.driver: Consumption growth fades toward the mid-20s as AI workloads disappoint and the multiple compresses

base.driver: Product growth decelerates from 36-38% to about 30% on a larger base with AI-driven consumption continuing; margin per FY27 guide of 14.5%

bull.driver: Growth stays in the mid-30s as the Q3 guide of 37-38% persists and AI products scale

valuation.implied_by_close: At $291 the market cap is about $110.6B (380M shares) and EV about $108.5B: 17.2x FY2027 estimated revenue and 13.2x base FY2028 revenue. The named-analyst targets ($430-$490) imply about 20-22x base FY2028 revenue, or FY2028 revenue near $12B at 14x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/revenue moves the base target by $21.6 (about 7.0 pp of the $307 base). Each 5 pp of FY2028 growth moves base revenue by $0.32B and the target by about $12 at 14x.
valuation.watch_metric: Product revenue growth versus the 37-38% Q3 guide, and net revenue retention, with non-GAAP product gross margin against the 74% guide.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY2027 results, expected 2 Dec 2026 after the close (outside this research cutoff).

analyst_notes: Named targets moved sharply up after the 2 Sep release (Morgan Stanley $300 to $470, Citi $395 to $490, BofA $395 to $470) and Evercore raised again to $430 on 12 Nov while the stock slid to $291, so named targets sit 48-68% above the close and 40-60% above the $307 base. The gap is mostly multiple: $430-$490 needs roughly 20-22x EV/revenue on base FY2028 revenue or about $12B of revenue at 14x. Horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target; post-report dates are the Sep 3 publication date, and Webull and Schaeffer's are secondary sources.
